entries.text: **Breakpoints in binary views**, set without a debug session and materialized when one starts. Click the gutter in the **WAT (virtualized)** or native **Disassembly** view; the breakpoint is anchored to the binary's content hash (not its path) and survives restarts. The gutter icon reports what the runtime did with it: registered, instruction-precise, degraded, or stale after a rebuild. Supported for GraalWasm/Node.js/browser, wasmtime, WAMR and firmware ELF (QEMU/Renode) sessions. Listed under "Hexana Binary Breakpoints" in the Breakpoints dialog; conditions and hit counts are not supported yet.

clusters.summary: Set a breakpoint directly in virtualized WAT or native disassembly before a debug session starts, then carry it with the binary across file moves and IDE restarts.
clusters.title: Keep breakpoints with the binary

entries.text: **Debugger Console** tab: an interactive command line to the underlying debugger — LLDB commands for wasmtime/WAMR/wasmtime-gdbstub sessions, GDB commands for firmware QEMU/Renode. Execution-control commands are routed through the IDE's own actions so the console cannot desync it. Not available for GraalWasm/CDP sessions.

clusters.summary: Use an interactive LLDB or GDB console alongside a paused supported debug session, while Hexana keeps execution commands synchronized with the IDE.
clusters.title: Send debugger commands without losing IDE control

entries.text: **Runtime compatibility for WebAssembly binaries.** Declare target runtimes under **Settings | Build, Execution, Deployment | WebAssembly | Runtime Compatibility** and every `.wasm` file is checked against them: the proposals badge turns into a warning for unsupported proposals and opens a new **Compatibility** tab. With nothing declared the tab lists which runtimes support each proposal. Verdicts come from WebAssembly's `features.json`; the declaration lives in `.hexana/runtimes.json`, shared with the VS Code extension.

clusters.summary: Declare the runtimes a project targets and inspect proposal-level compatibility directly from a WASM file.
clusters.title: Check the runtimes your WASM targets

entries.text: **Smali** tab for Android `.dex` files showing baksmali-style Dalvik bytecode with resolved operands and decoded switch/fill-array payloads; clicking an instruction row moves the hex view to that code unit

clusters.summary: Open Android DEX files in a baksmali-style view with resolved operands and byte-linked instruction rows.
clusters.title: Read Android DEX as Smali

entries.text: **Structural regions in the hex view for every format Hexana parses** — previously WebAssembly and ELF only. Region tinting, labels, prev/next navigation and the **Structure** tool window now also cover ZIP/JAR and TAR entries, `ar` members, COFF sections, DEX id tables, PCAP/PCAP-NG packets, Parquet row groups, Arrow batches, `resources.arsc` packages, class files and protobuf descriptors. Where a region matches a table the editor renders, its label switches to that tab.

clusters.summary: Navigate named binary regions in the hex view and the Structure tool window for formats beyond WebAssembly and ELF.
clusters.title: See structure across binary formats
